title: 開鎖佬
subject: a 24-hour locksmith in Kwun Tong on one night's calls: he refuses to open the door for a drunk young man whose girlfriend has locked him out, frees an old woman's cat that shut itself in her bathroom, and at dawn finds he has lost his own keys and has to call his apprentice, who charges him the full fee
caption: Cantonese-language corridos tumbados, modern Mexican street-corrido style. A requinto guitar playing fast tremolo runs and trills between every vocal line, a twelve-string bajo quinto strumming tight syncopated chords, a tololoche upright bass slapped on the beat, and a light charcheta sousaphone doubling the bass in the choruses. Intimate, dry live-band recording with the guitars upfront and a warm low end. Male Cantonese lead with a nasal, laid-back baritone, telling the story in a half-sung storyteller delivery with a slight drawl. 138 BPM, A minor. Deadpan, swaggering and tongue-in-cheek. No trap hi-hats, no 808s, no reggaeton beat, no mariachi trumpets, no banda brass section, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
觀塘有個開鎖佬 人人叫佢陳師傅
一個工具袋 一支電筒 廿四個鐘都接
冇門佢開唔到 冇鎖佢唔識
一條鐵線 十秒 你屋企道門就開

[Pre-Chorus]
半夜三點 電話一響
佢落樓 對拖鞋都唔換

[Chorus]
開鎖佬 開鎖佬 陳師傅嚟到
十秒開門 收你六百
唔使多謝 唔使解釋
下次記得 鎖匙放褲袋

[Verse]
第一單牛頭角 有個後生仔飲醉
著住對襪 坐喺門口地下
話女朋友喺入面 點都唔肯開
陳師傅望一望 話呢單我唔做

[Pre-Chorus]
後生仔話 我畀雙倍
陳師傅話 你同佢講啦

[Chorus]
開鎖佬 開鎖佬 陳師傅嚟到
有啲門 唔係鐵線開得到
唔收你錢 送你一句
講聲對唔住 好過搵我

[Verse]
第二單秀茂坪 有個婆婆喊住打嚟
佢隻貓自己 閂埋咗廁所門
婆婆喺門口 叫咗佢成個鐘
陳師傅鐵線一撩 隻貓仲嬲佢嚟遲

[Bridge]
天光收工 返到自己舖頭
一摸褲袋 嗰串鎖匙唔見咗
開咗一世鎖嘅陳師傅 企喺閘口

[Chorus]
開鎖佬 開鎖佬 徒弟嚟到
十秒開閘 照收六百
仲拍拍佢膊頭 話師傅
下次記得 鎖匙放褲袋

[Outro]
觀塘開鎖佬 廿四個鐘都接
